title: Response case
description: A recorded response and the values the SDK must parse it to. The mock replays it under the scenario response/<id>. expect holds exactly one of decision (decide), answer (check, classify, score, number), models (models), raw (decide_raw), batch (a Batch: create, add, finalize, get, cancel), batch_page (list), batch_results (results), session (open_session) or upload_ids.

models.description: One ModelInfo per entry, in order. Suite 1.11: fine_tuned, base, adapter_version and status are the entry's own fields (null when it has none, as a catalogue entry); each is checked when the case lists it.

limits.description: Every field of the entry other than the three above.

batch.description: Every field of the batch object as sent; nested objects compare by the keys given. From suite 1.17 a value of {"$absent": true} means the field must not be there (price_factor: the batch object states no price).

session.description: The Session's fields (the open response's), answers typed as decide's.

collection.description: Suite 1.13: the collections call's object as sent; nested objects compare by the keys given.

item.description: Suite 1.13: the collections call's object as sent; nested objects compare by the keys given.

item_page.description: Suite 1.13: the collections call's object as sent; nested objects compare by the keys given.

deleted.description: Suite 1.13: the collections call's object as sent; nested objects compare by the keys given.

collections.description: Suite 1.13: the list of collections, in order.

key_usage.description: Suite 1.18: usage.key's object as sent; nested objects compare by the keys given, lists whole.

usage_page.description: Suite 1.18: usage.list's page as sent; nested objects compare by the keys given, lists whole.
